name: lint-on-save
description: Runs the linter on each edited file and hands the errors straight back to Claude.

includeWarnings.title: Include warnings
includeWarnings.description: Also hand Claude the linter's warnings (eslint severity 1, shellcheck notes), not just its errors.

disabled.title: Disabled linters
disabled.description: Comma-separated linters never to run: eslint, ruff, golangci-lint, clippy, shellcheck.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long one linter run may take before it is stopped.
